spacing_and_layout.padding_scale: p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12 (Use generous spacing, minimum p-6 for padded cards)
spacing_and_layout.container_borders: Cards must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision. Use 1px subtle borders instead of heavy shadows.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons/pills to feel organic.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Images max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Stack components. Grid cols-1 on mobile.

surface_strategies.cards: Neumorphism (Tactile) - Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow, border color darkens.
surface_strategies.header: Glassmorphism (Optical Clarity) - backdrop-blur-xl with high opacity (bg-white/80 light, bg-black/60 dark). 1px delicate inner stroke.
surface_strategies.buttons: Primary buttons: Pill shape (rounded-full), solid primary color. Secondary: Outline with transparent background, solid border.

components.navigation: Sticky top nav with backdrop-blur. Logo left, links center, CTA right. Hamburger menu for mobile.
components.dashboard_grid: Mode B (Control Room Grid). Tight gaps (gap-6). Use col-span-1 for summary metrics, col-span-2 or 3 for main charts.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn charts. Transparent background, crisp lines. Use primary and accent colors for data series.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Customize to use rounded-xl, organic borders.
components.toggle: Bilingual (PT/EN) and Theme (Dark/Light) toggles in header or profile dropdown.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons and cards must have hover states. Lighter hue for active state. MUST explicitly set text color on hover.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Framer motion staggered entrance for dashboard cards and lists.

icons.style: Clean, line-based, consistent stroke width (1.5px or 2px).

hero_landing.description: Young woman in yellow coat using smartphone outdoors - represents target audience (young adults) engaging with the app happily.

abstract_background.description: Abstract warm sand texture - use for premium section backgrounds or organic soft textures on landing page.

testing.data_testid: MANDATORY for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, toggles, links) using kebab-case role-based names.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement bilingual support (PT-BR/EN) using a context or standard i18n approach.
Dark/Light theme toggle must switch the CSS variables defined in colors.
Freemium vs Premium features must be visually distinct. Premium features should be marked with a small subtle 'Premium' badge or the Accent color (Terracotta).
Ensure gamification elements (metas/conquistas) use progress bars with the Accent color for high energy.
Avoid standard Vercel/Shadcn look. Strip default shadows, use the defined 1px borders and specific fonts.
Use framer-motion for smooth staggered list animations on the dashboard.
For the Landing Page CTA, ensure high contrast and use the Accent color to drive conversion.
